'''Ragan Ten''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taul/Legends|Taul]], along with [[Red Wing squad|Red Wing]] and [[Pounders squad]]s, to retrieve an object of unknown origin. Ten participated in a [[skirmish on Taul]].
